Title: How to Transfer Nintendo Switch SD Card Data to a New SD Card
IntroLines: Upgraded to a larger SD card for your Nintendo Switch?
In this video, I'll show you how to safely transfer all your games and data to your new SD card using a computer.

Sections.Heading: STEP 1: COPY THE NINTENDO FOLDER TO YOUR COMPUTER
Steps: •  First, press and hold the power button on your Nintendo Switch for three seconds.
•  Select **" Power Options "** .
•  Select **" Turn Off "** .
•  Open the kickstand on the back and remove your old microSD card from the slot.
•  Insert your old microSD card into your computer's card reader.
•  Open **" File Explorer "** on your PC.
•  Click on your microSD card drive from the left sidebar.
•  Right-click on the folder named **" Nintendo "** .
•  Select **" Copy "** .
•  Go to your computer's **" Desktop "** .
•  Right-click on an empty space and select **" Paste "** .
•  Wait for the **" Nintendo "** folder to finish copying completely to your computer.
•  Right-click your microSD card drive in File Explorer and select **" Eject "** .
•  Remove the old microSD card from your computer.
Sections.Bridge: Once the files are saved on your computer, let's move them onto your new SD card.

Sections.Heading: STEP 2: TRANSFER THE NINTENDO FOLDER TO YOUR NEW SD CARD
Steps: •  First, insert your new microSD card into your computer's card reader.
•  Open **" File Explorer "** on your PC.
•  Click on your new microSD card drive from the left sidebar.
•  Make sure the card is completely empty or delete any existing files on it.
•  Now, go back to your **" Desktop "** where you saved the backup.
•  Right-click on the **" Nintendo "** folder.
•  Select **" Copy "** .
•  Go back to your new microSD card drive in **" File Explorer "** .
•  Right-click on an empty space inside the drive.
•  Select **" Paste "** .
•  Wait for the entire **" Nintendo "** folder to finish copying to the new card.
•  Right-click on the new microSD card drive and select **" Eject "** .
•  Remove the new microSD card from your computer.
Sections.Bridge: Now that your data is transferred, let's put the new card into your Switch and verify everything works.

Sections.Heading: STEP 3: INSERT THE NEW SD CARD AND VERIFY YOUR GAMES
Steps: •  First, make sure your Nintendo Switch is still completely powered off.
•  Open the kickstand on the back of your console.
•  Insert your new microSD card into the slot until it clicks into place.
•  Close the kickstand.
•  Press the power button to turn on your Nintendo Switch.
•  If prompted with a system update for the new SD card, select **" Update "** .
•  From the home screen, select **" System Settings "** .
•  Scroll down the left sidebar and select **" Data Management "** .
•  Check the **" microSD Card "** section on the right to verify your new storage space.
•  Finally, launch one of your installed games to confirm that all your data loads properly.

OutroLines: And that's how you can transfer your Nintendo Switch SD card data to a new SD card.
